summary: F2F48 iter 32 — Group C2 Thumbnail Engine. Backend pytest: 17/17 PASS (auth gating x5, /me/quota thumb fields x2, rewriter, premium-locked-for-T1, quota-exhausted-402, refund-decrement x2, end-to-end Fast generate→list→file-stream→delete→404). Frontend Playwright: nav-thumbnails link, page render, 10/10 composer testids, engine + aspect segmented toggles, quota pill 'Owner · unlimited', rewriter (14→740 chars) + toast, Fast generation (size>50k, image streamed), tile actions (download/copy/delete), Scripts→Thumbnails handoff via localStorage seed (topic + seed both pre-filled, key cleared post-consume, 'Pre-filled from your script' banner). Smoke nav for /scripts /studio /resources /admin /thumbnails: 0 console errors. ONE real Gemini call burned across all tests as planned. No regressions vs iter 31.
critical_code_review_comments: thumbnails_routes.py is a clean 580-line module — well under the 700-line soft limit. Provider abstraction (_generate_image_bytes dispatcher) makes future engines (Imagen, Flux, etc.) easy to add.
Quota gate + refund mirrors the render-quota pattern in server.py; refund is idempotent (founders guard + upsert=False).

GridFS bucket 'thumbnails' is correctly isolated from the 'uploads' bucket. Dedicated /api/thumbnails/file/{id} streamer is intentionally no-auth (UUID hex file IDs are unguessable) — file existence is the only authz check and soft-deleted entries 404 correctly.

_public_url uses os.environ.get('PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL', '') — PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is NOT set in /app/backend/.env, so URLs are returned as relative paths ('/api/thumbnails/file/{id}.png'). Frontend then prefixes with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via apiClient. Works correctly but worth noting as a relative-URL contract.
ThumbnailRewriteRequest.raw_prompt min_length=2 is quite permissive; could lead to garbage rewrites for 2-char inputs. Not a blocker; cosmetic.

stream_thumbnail_file uses bson.ObjectId(clean_id) but db.thumbnails stores _id as str(object_id). Cross-check uses string lookup ({'_id': clean_id}) which is correct. Two-step validation (GridFS oid + soft-delete flag) is a nice belt-and-suspenders design.

server.py grew to 3898 lines — still over the 700-line soft limit flagged in iter 31. Thumbnail routes were correctly extracted into their own module, which sets a good precedent for future splits (quota.py, activity.py, auth.py).

For T1 quota tests, ephemeral buyers were seeded directly in db.buyers via pymongo with tier='t1', founders=false, thumbnailQuotaMonthly=20, thumbnailsThisCycle=<test value>, thumbnailPremiumAllowed=False, then auth'd via POST /api/auth/check. All cleaned up in fixture teardown.
seed_data_creation: Test creates ephemeral T1 buyers (test_t1_thumb_*, test_t1_full_*, test_refund_*) per test with full cleanup. Verified post-run: 0 stale test buyers + 0 orphaned thumbnail docs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Group C2 Thumbnail Engine GREEN. The Scripts→Thumbnails handoff contract uses localStorage key 'f48_handoff_thumbnail' with shape {topic, seed, script_id, platform, ts} (NOT 'prompt' — the prompt textarea is populated from 'seed'). Thumbnails.jsx clears the key after consumption via localStorage.removeItem. The /api/thumbnails/file/{id} streamer is INTENTIONALLY no-auth (UUID-hex unguessable IDs); confirmed it returns 400 for bad oids and 404 for missing/soft-deleted entries — no 401. /api/me/quota for owner/grant/founder returns {unlimited: true, tier_id, tier_label} only (no thumbnail_* fields); only non-founder paying buyers get the thumbnail_used/total/remaining/premium_allowed quartet. Test cost across all runs: 1 Gemini Nano Banana call + ~6 Claude rewriter calls via the Emergent Universal LLM key. No Premium gpt-image-1 calls were made (engine routing verified at quota-gate layer only).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration. Initial Playwright handoff test temporarily appeared to fail because the test used the wrong localStorage key ('prompt' instead of 'seed') — corrected and re-verified GREEN. The Scripts.jsx sendToThumbnails helper correctly extracts the narration hook and stores it as 'seed', and Thumbnails.jsx correctly reads 'seed' into the prompt textarea.
